title: Pipelined vectorize bulk import: async job reconciliation + idempotent key semantics
creator: Miguel Rivera
description:
Problem: Customers with large document collections need a robust, low-latency path for producing embeddings at scale. Current ad-hoc streaming uploads either overload the encoder fleet or require manual retries and deduplication on the client. This leads to increased latency, higher token costs, and occasional duplicate vectors in stores.

Goal: Implement a pipelined bulk ingestion API that accepts streaming and batch payloads, schedules asynchronous vectorization jobs, guarantees at-least-once delivery while providing idempotent semantics to avoid duplicates, and exposes reconciliation tooling and observability for long-running imports. The feature should be backwards-compatible with existing batch endpoints and integrate with our reranking/lookup flows.

High-level approach:
- Introduce a POST /v1/embeddings/bulk-import endpoint that returns an import_job_id immediately. Payload supports ndjson streams or multipart uploads.
- On accept, write a compact manifest to the import-store and enqueue an async job. Manifest contains per-record idempotency_key, source_hash, and minimal metadata needed for dedupe.
- Vectorization runs in a pipelined fashion: sanitize -> shard -> encode -> store. Encoding tasks are scheduled in prioritized worker pools with continuous batching windows (configurable by job).
- Idempotency: clients provide idempotency_key (UUID or client-provided token). Keys are stored with a sliding dedupe window (default 30 days). The import controller deduplicates at manifest-apply time and again after encode before commit to vector store to avoid race duplicates.
- Partial commits: support checkpointing of encoded shards and resume semantics for interrupted jobs. Resume uses manifest + last_committed_offset.
- Retries: transient worker failures use exponential backoff with bounded retries. For permanently failed records, mark as failed with error reasons visible in job status.
- Reconciliation: admin endpoint to re-run reconcile/import cleanup for orphaned manifests and to compact duplicate keys. Reconciliation job exports a report with counts and sample ids.

Non-goals: deep dedupe by semantic similarity, upstream document canonicalization (for now), or streaming real-time inference within the same request.
acceptance_criteria:
- New bulk-import endpoint accepts ndjson and multipart uploads and returns import_job_id synchronously.
- Jobs appear in /v1/embeddings/imports/{job_id} with progress and failures.
- No duplicate vectors are stored when identical idempotency_key is submitted multiple times within the dedupe window.
- Partial resume works: interrupt a job mid-run, restart upload with same manifest and resume from last_committed_offset.
- End-to-end test coverage for success, transient worker failure, and permanent record failure.
- Performance target: average encode latency per-record with batching within 1.2x of existing single-request encoder for typical batch sizes, and throughput scales linearly across worker pool sizes.
implementation_notes:
Implementation will touch: API gateway (new route), import-store (manifest schema), async queue (add job type 'VECTORIZE_IMPORT'), worker pool with batching windows, commit reconciler, and dashboard integration.

Key data model decisions: store only idempotency_key, source_hash, source_uri, record_index, and client_metadata in manifest. Keep full payloads in cold blob-store for replay up to 7 days.

Encoder changes: allow a 'dry-encode' mode that produces deterministically-hashed vector fingerprints for fast dedupe checks (optional). Use existing continuous-batching codepath; ensure KV cache reuse across job tasks.
rollout_plan:
1) Feature-flag gated in staging.
2) Run small-scale dogfood imports from internal datasets.
3) Gradually enable for opt-in customers with <100k records.
4) Monitor job success/failure rates and tail latencies for 48 hours.
5) Open beta for larger tenants with support on call.
6) Remove feature flag after 2 successful quarters and wide usage.
test_plan:
- Unit tests for manifest creation, dedupe logic, resume logic, and manifest compaction.
- Integration tests that spin up a worker pool emulator and verify pipeline with synthetic ndjson payloads.
- Fault-injection tests: drop worker, slow encode, storage transient failures.
- Load test: 10M records across 100 concurrent jobs in staging, measure throughput and storage commit rates.
monitoring_and_metrics:
Expose the following metrics: import_jobs_started, import_jobs_succeeded, import_jobs_failed, records_processed_total, records_failed_total, duplicate_records_skipped, average_batch_size, encoding_latency_p50/p95/p99, manifest_apply_latency.

Add dashboards: per-job timeline, tail error traces for failed records, idempotency-key collision rate, and storage commit lag. Alert rules for job_failure_rate > 1% over 10m and encoding_p99 > baseline_threshold.
comments: 2025-11-04 Miguel Rivera: Kickoff meeting notes: agreement on manifest-first approach and keeping payloads in cold blob for replay. Action: Asha to draft API spec and manifest schema.

2025-11-11 Asha Patel: Uploaded initial OpenAPI spec to design doc (link in design_links). Decided to support both ndjson streaming and multipart for large binary payloads. Need decision on default dedupe window (proposal: 30 days).

2025-12-01 SRE: Noted potential hot-shard risk when many small imports target same tenant. Suggested per-tenant concurrency limits and backpressure. Action: add per-tenant token bucket to import controller.

2026-01-08 Asha Patel: Prototype worker implemented. Early measurements show encode p95 within 1.15x of single-request baseline when batching window=50ms. Found edge-case where duplicate idempotency_key arrives after a worker crash — added post-encode dedupe check before commit.
2026-01-22 QA: Integration tests added for resume semantics and failure injection. One flaky test for multipart boundary parsing — tracked in ENG-27618.
2026-02-10 Security: Review completed. No sensitive PII stored in manifest; cold blob access control required. Added requirement to integrate with KMS for manifest encryption at rest.

2026-02-15 Asha Patel: Switched status to In Progress. Preparing staging rollout and load test plan. PRs: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4821 (api + controller), https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4834 (worker changes).
